```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
library(PEcAn.all)
library(PEcAn.utils)
library(PEcAn.settings)
library(PEcAn.workflow)
```

## Set Up Environment

```{r setup-environment}
# Set the path to the PEcAn settings file
settings_file <- "path/to/pecan.xml"

# Read the settings
settings <- read.settings(settings_file)
```

## Run Workflow

```{r run-workflow}
# Run the PEcAn workflow
runModule.run.write.configs(settings)
runModule_start_model_runs(settings)
```

## Visualize Results

```{r visualize-results}
# Load the results
results <- load.results(settings)

# Plot the results
plot.results(results)
```
